flags.reason: misreads-source: The middle slot is a bare `<Text numberOfLines={1} modes={...}>`. The sources section says examples use "the published Storybook TitleText fixture for the middle slot", and the evidence says the fixture uses React Native `Text` with inline `{ fontSize: 16, fontWeight: 'bold', color: ... }` and no `modes` prop. Native `Text` accepts no `modes`, so the example drops the fixture's styling and adds a prop that nothing cited supports.

misreads-source: Same issue as /examples/0. The middle slot passes `modes` to native `Text` and omits the fixture's inline 16px bold style and its mode-keyed color, but the guide says it reuses the TitleText fixture verbatim.

notes: /content/good includes "Go back", which is an accessibilityLabel and not a title. Check whether the good-content list is meant to hold title examples only. /configuration/10 ("Set modes on AppBar") is an inference: the evidence only says AppBar resolves modes and cascades them to direct slot children, yet the examples also pass modes to every child explicitly. /configuration/7's "one low-emphasis action" comes from a single Do card; the canonical MainPage story uses two actions, so an agent should not read it as a one-action limit.
